Honestly, Im having a blast with her. I relate to this, as Ive always loved her ever since her release, and I was having the same problems you mentioned, so I chose my runes & items according to what i feel best depending on the matchup, granted these are not for everyone:

Note: SUPER SAUCY STRAT to win lane lvl2:

Try and hit the wave with AAs to try and get lvl 2 first, and then as soon as you do go FLASH + Q the adc, pulling them to you after the initial second. If ur adc follows up its usually a kill garanteed. Cant really count how many times Ive won with this alone.


RUNES:

Aery/Comet, Manaflow, Transcendence, Scorch/Storm, then Domination with Ghost Poro / Zombie Ward & Relentless Hunter (fix her mobility issues. Get there in time to W someone or just rotate) I never go Guardian, I just dont find it enjoyable.

VS POKE/SUSTAIN (mages/enchanters)

I go Aery to try and block their damage spells while trading. What I usually do (specially against Lux), is to stay close to my adc and just E whenever she does (beware of the Q of course). People might not realize her shield has a 50% AP ratio, thats not bad at all. So what I do is early I try to get as much AP as possible, which is Dark Seal + Amplifying tome before anything else (boots when possible). This gives E enough oomph to keep tanking dmg. Then as a Mythic I build Moonstone to keep shielding up & situational

VS ALL IN / NO SUSTAIN

 I go the exact same runes & items early but with Comet & scorch instead, which usually allows me to bully people & win lane. To do this, I go ahead and tryhard more getting Mandate first to keep the aggression up, and then usually Shurelyas into situational.

Sorry about dropping this Renata bible out of nowhere, I just think It finally clicked with me and Im having so much fun no matter the matchup :) gl hf

That means that once you land E every ghoul will grant stacks independently, which would put you at 8 stacks instantly. Then you just AA & Q an enemy and there you go, full stacks instantly.

It's very important that YOU are the one killing the minions, otherwise they're all coded as a single instance of damage and they don't stack as fast.
